definitions.explanation: Representing the standard or norm for a group. Can be neutral (statistically average) or slightly negative (unremarkable, nothing special).

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧くらいです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is the average height of a Japanese person?

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧⟦{変化|へんか}している→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧。
examples.english: The income of the average household changes year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{平均的|へいきんてき}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{部活動|ぶかつどう}→部活動：14539_bukatsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目覚|めざ}ましい→目覚ましい：13628_mezamashii⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せている→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: His grades are average, but he's shown remarkable performance in club activities.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧ (average) with the suffix ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (forming na-adjectives). A very productive pattern in Japanese — ⟦{基本的|きほんてき}→基本的：04787_kihonteki⟧ (basic), ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧ (general), ⟦{典型的|てんけいてき}→典型的：04801_tenkeiteki⟧ (typical) all follow the same structure.

USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective modifier ({平均的|へいきんてき}な + noun) or as an adverb ({平均的|へいきんてき}に). Can describe statistical averages or, more loosely, what is considered normal or ordinary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧: an average build
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧: an average income
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧: the average Japanese person
- {平均的|へいきんてき}に⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧: looking at it on average

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: normal, ordinary — more colloquial and broader, covering social norms as well as averages
- ⟦{標準的|ひょうじゅんてき}→標準的：05668_hyoujunteki⟧な: standard — implies conforming to an established norm or benchmark
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧な: general, common — focuses on what is widely seen or accepted
